### Fee busy-wait → persistent worker pool
The 30 ms spin in `legacyLedgerSync` is **byte-for-byte preserved** in [`feeWorkerPoolEntry.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp3a-naive-claude/src/workers/feeWorkerPoolEntry.js) — same arithmetic, same rounding. ### Idempotency
Clients send `x-client-order-id` header. [`idempotencyStore.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp3a-naive-claude/src/services/idempotencyStore.js) caches the response for `IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_MS` (default 5 min). Duplicate requests get the cached response and never touch the order book.

### Circuit breaker
[`circuitBreaker.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp3a-naive-claude/src/services/circuitBreaker.js) implements the classic three-state model per symbol. It subscribes to `pricing.emitter` ticks and computes a rolling-window `(max−min)/min` move. When that exceeds `CB_MAX_MOVE_PCT` (default 5 %) it goes `OPEN` (HTTP 503) for `CB_COOLDOWN_MS` (default 30 s), then `HALF_OPEN` to probe recovery.

### WebSocket real-time feed
[`wsService.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp3a-naive-claude/src/services/wsService.js) attaches a `ws` server to the existing HTTP server on the same port (`/ws`). Broadcasts `order_book_update`, `trade_executed`, and `circuit_breaker` frames. Clients can subscribe/filter channels.
